0.why: PICore.cc:44 takes the voice count from this jack and PICore.cc:67 reads it per voice
PICore.cc:87 scales the envelope, which PICore.cc:194 clamps at envelopeHighVoltage, set at 9V in PICore.cc:149; PICore.cc:48 sets the channel count from the input

1.why: PICore.cc:88 scales the inverted envelope from PICore.cc:82, which starts at the 9V set in PICore.cc:149; PICore.cc:49 sets the channel count from the input

2.why: PICore.cc:84 puts out gateOutHighVoltage, set at 8V in PICore.cc:145; PICore.cc:45 sets the channel count from the input

3.why: PICore.cc:89 puts out the value clamped at 12V either way in PICore.cc:68; PICore.cc:50 sets the channel count from the input

4.why: PICore.cc:85 puts out the envelope, which PICore.cc:194 clamps at the 9V set in PICore.cc:149; PICore.cc:46 sets the channel count from the input

5.why: PICore.cc:86 subtracts the envelope from the 9V set in PICore.cc:149; PICore.cc:47 sets the channel count from the input

comment: The gate threshold is 3.5V measured after the gain switch and the sensitivity knob (PICore.cc:147 and PICore.cc:169), so what counts as a hit depends on both. The expander the maker's manual describes is not part of this plugin: there is one PI module and no expander model.
